evidence.quote:
At inner core conditions, an Fe94.5 Ni5.5 alloy would have a 125% greater 
strength than Fe.

The strength of the inner core may be higher than was previously reported by Gleason et al. 2013, as we expect the strength of Fe94.5Ni5.5 to be higher than that of pure Fe, but still within the range to support dislocation creep as the dominant deformation mechanism.
Dislocation creep is likely the dominant mechanism in the Earth’s inner core.
